subject: PilotX pilot: temporary quota uplift and blended overrun tiers
messages:
From: Alyssa Park <alyssa@pilotx.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot launch week -- urgent quota uplift request

Hi Markus,

We kick off PilotX's public beta next Monday and our usage projection for day one doubled in the last 24 hours. Can Redwood temporarily increase our quota and raise soft rate limits for the first 72 hours of the pilot? We want to avoid any throttling during the critical launch window.

Attached is our expected call volume by hour (PilotX_Month1_Usage.csv). High-level ask: +3x quota for 72 hours, with an agreed overrun rate for any traffic beyond that.

Also looping in our Ops and procurement: Samir (procurement) and PilotX Ops.

Thanks,
Alyssa
Alyssa Park
Head of Platform, PilotX
Alyssa.Park@pilotx.com

Attachment: PilotX_Month1_Usage.csv (csv, 24KB)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Park <alyssa@pilotx.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot launch week -- urgent quota uplift request

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks for the heads up and the CSV; congrats on the launch. We can do a temporary uplift for the 72-hour launch window. To keep both sides protected, I propose the following approach:

- Temporary quota uplift: 3x baseline capacity for 72 hours starting 2027-09-20 00:00 PDT.
- Blended overrun tiers for any usage beyond uplift:
  - Tier A (0–25% over uplift): $0.08 / 1k tokens
  - Tier B (25–100% over uplift): $0.18 / 1k tokens
  - Tier C (>$100% over uplift): $0.35 / 1k tokens + throttling safeguards
- We’ll enable a hard cap at +250% unless you instruct otherwise.
- Billing: estimated uplift charged at forecasted usage up front as a one-time pilot surcharge; true-up at month close.

I attached a short PDF with the blended-overrun proposal and proposed amendment language. Ben (Sales Ops) will handle the DocuSign amendment and invoice timing; Marissa (Account Manager) will run the rollout playbook with our infra team.

If this looks good, we can lock terms and Ben will send the DocuSign today for signature.

Best,

Markus Klein
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood-blended-overrun-proposal.pdf (pdf, 42KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samir Bedi <samir.bedi@pilotx.com>, Alyssa Park <alyssa@pilotx.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: PilotX pilot uplift — amendment & invoicing

Hi Samir / Alyssa,

Looping in on invoicing and the legal amendment. Per Markus’ note: we prepared a short-term amendment that captures the 72-hour uplift and the blended overrun tiers. Key commercial points:

- Uplift charge: invoiced as a one-time pilot surcharge on your next monthly invoice.
- True-up: final consumption reconciliation at month-end; any overages billed against the blended tiers above.
- Discount: as a pilot courtesy we can offer a 10% discount on Tier A overrun charges if PilotX accepts the amendment within 48 hours.
- Payment terms: Net 30 by default; if you need Net 45 we can accommodate for PilotX given CC approval.

DocuSign link below for the amendment. Please review and sign so we can provision the temporary uplift before your launch.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/launch?envelopeId=2a7f9d
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4891

Thanks — I’ll standby to issue the pilot surcharge invoice as soon as the amendment is signed.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

---
Note: Attachment referenced in the amendment: redwood-blended-overrun-proposal.pdf (same as Markus' attachment).

From: Samir Bedi <samir.bedi@pilotx.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Alyssa Park <alyssa@pilotx.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot launch week -- urgent quota uplift request

Ben / Markus,

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Two quick confirmations before we sign:

1) Can you confirm the invoice posting date? We prefer the surcharge to post on 2027-09-20 to align with our internal accruals.
2) Regarding the 10% Tier A discount — is that conditional on a signature within 48 hours of Ben’s email (2027-09-14 08:30 PDT)? If so, we’ll prioritize.

If both are OK we’ll sign the DocuSign today and notify you.

Thanks,
Samir Bedi
Head of Procurement, PilotX
samir.bedi@pilotx.com
